# oriel

> oriel ("oriel for Windows") is an MCP server that lets Claude Code use your Windows apps. It reads each window as text through the Windows accessibility tree (UI Automation), presses, fills and selects controls through UI Automation so those actions don't move the mouse, and replies to every action with what changed. Free and open source under the Apache License 2.0. The Claude Code CLI has no built-in computer use on Windows (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/computer-use, read 10 Nov 2026).

- One exe, `oriel.exe`, under 200 KB. It runs on the .NET Framework 4.8 that Windows includes, installs for your Windows account only, and needs no admin rights.
- Supported: Windows 11 (tested); Windows 10 version 1903 or later (not tested yet).
- MCP clients: tested with Claude Code only. Any client that starts a stdio MCP server should work; the configs for Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code follow each client's documented format but aren't tested.
- Also: a Claude Code plugin, an `.mcpb` bundle for Claude Desktop (not tested yet), and the MCP Registry entry `io.github.YordiLorenzo/oriel`. `io.github.ParadoxInfinite/oriel` is a different project.
- Tools: `windows`, `tree`, `find`, `text`, `wait`, `screenshot`, `invoke`, `set`, `select`, `scroll`, `keys`, `click`, `drag`, `launch`, `window`, `focus`, `close`, `status`, `batch`.
- Every action replies with what changed in the window (`+` new, `~` changed, `-` gone). `invoke`, `set`, `select` and `scroll` don't take keyboard focus or move the mouse; `keys`, `click` and `drag` do.
- Safety: password fields can't be filled, read or typed into; the lock screen, sign-in and UAC prompts, credential dialogs, common password managers and open terminals are off limits; no shell or file tools by default. It is not a sandbox: in an allowed window it acts as you. oriel makes no network connections except to itself on 127.0.0.1. No telemetry.
- From a Mac or Linux machine, Claude Code can use a Windows PC over SSH. oriel needs no admin rights; turning on OpenSSH Server needs admin once.
- oriel-vnc, the second MCP server in the repo, operates macOS, Linux or any desktop with a VNC server through screenshots, clicks and keys. Install it with `claude mcp add --scope user oriel-vnc -- uvx oriel-vnc` (from PyPI, needs uv).
- Not code-signed yet: SmartScreen warns, and Smart App Control, where it is on, blocks it. Every release lists its hash in `SHA256SUMS`, and `gh attestation verify oriel.exe -R YordiLorenzo/oriel` checks that the release workflow built it.
- WindowsAgentArena round 9 (Microsoft's benchmark, October 2026, 153 tasks, Claude Sonnet 5.5 in Claude Code on both sides, two runs each), oriel against Cua Driver 0.38.0: median time per task 49 s against 70 s (30% less), model cost $38 against $61 per run (38% less; the cost Claude Code reported, a list-price estimate), 21.8 against 27.0 turns per task (19% fewer). Each of these gaps holds at 95% confidence (a bootstrap over the 153 tasks, `bench/waa/stats.py`) and is larger than either layer's own run-to-run gap. Cua Driver completed 4 points more tasks: 67% against 63%. Its own two runs differed by 6.5 points, so that gap is within run-to-run variation, but it completed more in every round since round 5. Cua Driver ran without 4 of its 63 tools, `run_script` among them.
- Per call on one unlocked Windows 11 PC (10 Nov 2026, median of 5 runs), oriel 0.1.0 against Cua Driver 0.46.1: list windows 1 ms against 30 ms, launch an app 192 ms against 604 ms, read a window 20 ms against 37 ms, fill a field 2 ms against 3 ms, press a button 2 ms against 5 ms. A press with its change report takes oriel one call (42 ms); Cua Driver needs a second call to see the change.
- oriel was never measured against Claude Desktop's or ChatGPT's computer use.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, Anthropic or Cua.

Set up with Claude Code, in PowerShell:

```
.\oriel.exe install
claude mcp add --scope user oriel -- "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\oriel\oriel.exe" mcp
```

Or both lines can be replaced by the Claude Code plugin, which carries its own `oriel.exe` (Claude Code 2.1.292 or later and Git for Windows; use one of the two):

```
claude plugin install oriel --marketplace YordiLorenzo/oriel
```

## Answers and guides

- [Does Claude Code computer use work on Windows?](https://yordilorenzo.github.io/oriel/claude-code-computer-use-windows/): not in the CLI; what Anthropic's docs say and what works on Windows
- [oriel and Cua Driver compared](https://yordilorenzo.github.io/oriel/oriel-vs-cua-driver/): WindowsAgentArena round 9 with its caveats, and per-call timings against Cua Driver 0.46.1
- [oriel and Windows-MCP compared](https://yordilorenzo.github.io/oriel/oriel-vs-windows-mcp/): how each works, and per-call timings from one locked PC (21 Oct 2026)
- [Use a Windows PC from your Mac with Claude Code](https://yordilorenzo.github.io/oriel/windows-from-mac-over-ssh/): oriel over SSH, with OpenSSH Server and key login
- [Let Claude Code test your Windows app](https://yordilorenzo.github.io/oriel/test-windows-app-claude-code/): build, launch and check your own app
